title: Fleshpunk Maze: From Toy Diagram to Tendon Machine

stages.title: Deterministic Baseline
stages.critique: Immediate and deterministic, but flat, toy-like, and not a credible machine. Preserved as the red starting point.
stages.change: First pixels: prompt contract to SVG to PNG.

stages.title: Structural Breakthrough
stages.critique: The gate becomes plausible machinery with pipes, valve, tendons, connective tissue, assembled and exploded views. Surface detail is too dense for strict line training.
stages.change: Generic diagram becomes professional fleshpunk engineering.

stages.title: Drive Corpus Extraction
stages.critique: All twenty legacy sources after deterministic ink extraction. Dense photos and fused organ masses visibly fail the no-blob gate.
stages.change: The learning source becomes visible and judgeable.

stages.title: Hard-Gated Projection
stages.critique: Eight separated mechanical survivors plus the authored pressure-valve supplement. Twelve bad plates are absent rather than averaged away.
stages.change: Density and silhouette gates prune the corpus.

stages.title: Clean Line Master
stages.critique: Readable assembly logic, real exploded parts, valve plumbing, tendon actuators, connective-tissue cuffs, service fasteners, and orthographic flow views.
stages.change: The target becomes useful maze machinery instead of decorative flesh.

stages.title: Training Binary
stages.critique: The same champion collapsed to pure black and white: zero gray, deterministic pixels, ready for LoRA continuation only after the user gate is signed.
stages.change: Visual master becomes an exact trainable projection.
